segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Retrieve the entity's UV texture coordinates. float2 uv = params.geometry().uv0(); // Models loaded from USDZ or Reality Composer use UVs that are flipped // on the y-axis. This compensates for that. uv.y = 1.0 - uv.y; // Sample the normal map texture based on the resulting UV coordinates. auto tex = params.textures(); float3 normal = (float3)tex.normal().sample(textureSampler, uv).rgb; // Set the sampled value as this pixel's normal. params.surface().set_normal(normal); ```
